Dynamic changes of serum vascular endothelial growth factor after surgical resection of hepatocellular carcinoma and its application in recurrence monitoring
abstractText: Background Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) recurs frequently after resection. Vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) mediates tumor angiogenesis, but its post-operative behavior is poorly described. We compared serum VEGF and alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) trajectories over the first post-operative year. Methodology In this single-center prospective pilot study, 21 patients undergoing curative resection were assessed and 19 analyzed (8 recurrence, 11 non-recurrence). Both markers were measured before surgery and at 3, 6 and 12 months. Trajectories were compared using mixed-effects models with a group × time interaction (time categorical) and a random intercept; VEGF was modeled on the native scale, AFP on the log 10 scale. All analyses are exploratory. Results Eight of 19 patients (42.1%) recurred, at a median of 177.5 days. VEGF trajectories differed between groups (interaction p = 0.041). In the recurrence group, estimated mean VEGF fell from 188.4 to 82.5 pg/mL by 3 months, rose to 103.9 at 6 months and fell to 67.9 at 12 months. Reductions from baseline were significant in the recurrence group only (all p ≤ 0.003). The 6-month rise was not itself significant (+21.2 pg/mL; p = 0.552). Observed VEGF never differed between groups; AFP was higher in the recurrence group at 12 months (15.61 versus 2.04 IU/mL; p = 0.016). Conclusion Serum VEGF declines markedly after resection, most steeply in patients who recur, and the groups follow different trajectories. The transient six-month rise coincided with the median time to recurrence but was not significant. Given the small, stage-imbalanced cohort, these findings are hypothesis-generating.

title: Remnant cholesterol, C-reactive protein, cholesterol-lowering medication, and cardiovascular outcome: novel findings from UK Biobank
abstractText: Background Despite substantial reductions in cardiovascular events with intensive LDL-C lowering, significant residual risk persists. Remnant cholesterol (RC) and C-reactive protein (CRP) reflect lipid dysregulation and inflammation, respectively, and may synergistically promote atherosclerosis. However, large-scale cohort evidence on their combined impact, particularly the quantitative interaction between the two and the modifying role of cholesterol-lowering therapy, remains limited. Methods This study included 376,817 participants with a median follow-up of 13.4 years. Cox proportional hazards regression models were used to evaluate the individual and joint associations of RC and CRP with major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) risk. Stratified analyses by cholesterol-lowering therapy were further conducted to explore its modifying effect on the combined risk. Results Both RC (≥0.8 mmol/L) and CRP (≥2 mg/L) were independently associated with MACE risk, with adjusted hazard ratios (HR) of 1.074 [95% confidence interval (CI): 1.024–1.126] and 1.168 (95% CI: 1.129–1.207), respectively. Concurrent elevation of both biomarkers conferred the highest risk (HR = 1.239, 95% CI: 1.167–1.316), and a significant positive multiplicative interaction was observed between RC and CRP. Stratified analyses suggested effect modification by cholesterol-lowering medication: the association between isolated RC elevation and MACE was attenuated in medication users, whereas risks remained significant for isolated CRP elevation and combined elevation of both markers. Conclusion Concurrent elevation of RC and CRP yields the highest MACE risk with a positive additive interaction. Cholesterol-lowering therapy reduces RC-related risk but not inflammation-driven risk in isolated CRP elevation. These findings support combined assessment of both biomarkers for personalized cardiovascular risk stratification.

title: Respiratory morbidity at age 4 across COVID-19 and pre-pandemic birth cohorts: the role of atopic risk
abstractText: Abstract The COVID-19 pandemic dramatically reduced early-life respiratory viral exposures, yet the long-term respiratory consequences for pandemic-born children remain unclear. We aimed to compare respiratory morbidity at age 4 between children born during versus before the pandemic and assess whether atopic risk modifies this association. This single-center birth cohort follow-up study included children born in February–March 2020 (COVID-19 cohort) and pre-pandemic controls born during the same period in 2019. Respiratory outcomes at age 4 were assessed using a structured telephone questionnaire (The International Study of Wheezing in Infants). The primary outcome was composite respiratory morbidity (CRM), defined as use of a short-acting bronchodilator (SABA), inhaled and/or oral corticosteroids, and/or emergency room visits for respiratory symptoms. Of 588 eligible children, 329 (55.9%) completed follow-up (139 COVID-19, 190 controls); baseline characteristics, including atopy prevalence, were comparable between cohorts. CRM during the fourth year of life was significantly more common in the COVID-19 cohort (39.6% vs. 27.4%, p = 0.02). In stratified analyses, CRM was markedly higher among atopic-risk pandemic-born children (atopic subgroup: n = 47 COVID-19, n = 68 controls) (66% vs. 27.9%, p < 0.001), but not among non-atopic children (26.1% vs. 27%). Multivariable logistic regression confirmed a significant COVID-19 cohort × atopy interaction for CRM (OR 5.04, 95% CI 1.83–13.89, p = 0.002), while neither factor alone was independently associated with the outcome. Conclusions : Birth during the COVID-19 pandemic was associated with increased preschool respiratory morbidity, particularly among children with atopic risk. These findings suggest that altered early-life microbial exposures may modify respiratory morbidity trajectories according to host atopic susceptibility. What is Known: • Children born during the COVID-19 pandemic had fewer respiratory infections and wheezing episodes in infancy due to reduced viral circulation. • Atopic predisposition is among the strongest risk factors for recurrent wheezing and persistent asthma in preschool children. What is New: • Pandemic-born children show significantly higher composite respiratory morbidity at age 4, but exclusively among those with atopic risk (OR 5.04). • Neither pandemic birth nor atopy alone predicts excess morbidity—only their combination does, suggesting host susceptibility shapes long-term respiratory trajectories.

Phage-based depletion of Variovorax reveals interactions within intact microbiomes
abstractText: Abstract Background Testing microbial interaction hypotheses, including metabolite cross-feeding, remains a major challenge in microbiome research. Phages have the potential to probe organism-organism interactions within complex microbiomes yet are rarely utilised for this purpose. Results Here, we isolated nine narrow host-range phages that replicate in several ecologically important Variovorax species. We used three of the phages to deplete Variovorax SCN45 from complex enrichment communities (containing 18 to 31 species) to test correlation network-based hypothesis of thiamine interdependencies . Genome-resolved metagenomics revealed that a Leifsonia population decreased in relative abundance following Variovorax SCN45 depletion but could be rescued by thiamine supplementation. As a further demonstration of this approach, we used phages to eliminate Variovorax CL14 from a defined rhizosphere co-culture grown with Arabidopsis , where Variovorax CL14 degrades the plant hormone auxin produced by Arthrobacter CL28, and re-established the stunted root phenotype. Conclusion Thus we confirmed thiamine production as the mechanistic basis for interdependence between Variovorax and Leifsonia . These experiments lay the foundation for research that employs wildtype and engineered phages to test interaction hypotheses and for targeted microbiome manipulation.

title: Reconfiguring interfacial hydrogen-bond networks to enhance anodic oxidation for efficient wastewater treatment
abstractText: Abstract Anodic oxidation is a pivotally electrochemical technology for wastewater treatment containing emerging contaminants such as isothiazolinone antimicrobials, but sluggish interfacial water-splitting kinetics for hydroxyl radical (•OH) formation and a limited oxidation range, constrain its industrial scalability. This study leverages Fe 3+ to strengthen interfacial water hydrogen bond, accelerating •OH formation and high-valent iron production, thus enhancing oxidation kinetics and scope. [Fe(OH)(H 2 O) 5 ] 2+ enhances the hydrogen-bond (H-bond) population at the electrode surface—particularly 4-HB-H 2 O motifs increase from 21% to 37% and weakens O–H bonds, due to its strong hydration and polarization ability. This reconfigured interfacial water H-bond structure markedly enhances water dissociation, leading to a 7-fold increase in the •OH concentration. Ultimately, Fe 3+ -mediated precise tuning of the H-bond network of water molecules enables non-selective degradation of diverse emerging contaminants, delivering stable long-term flow operation of 500 hours with ~95% removal efficiency maintained for contaminant. The system achieves a 44.3% cost reduction relative to conventional boron-doped diamond electrodes, establishing a convenient approach for industrial-scale electrochemical water treatment.

title: Family functioning and perceived academic achievement of adolescents from variable-centered and person-centered perspectives: the roles of teacher support and psychological capital
abstractText: Introduction Academic achievement is of paramount importance for adolescent development. However, how family functioning affects academic achievement through psychological capital (PsyCap), and the role of teacher support in this process, remain largely unexplored. Moreover, whether PsyCap exhibits heterogeneous profiles and how different environmental factors distinguish among them warrant further investigation. Method A survey was conducted among 1,288 students from eight junior high schools in Jiangxi Province, China, using cluster and convenience sampling. Hayes’ PROCESS macro was used to test the moderated mediation model. Latent profile analysis (LPA) was conducted to explore the heterogeneous latent taxonomy of PsyCap. Results Significant positive correlations were observed among family functioning, PsyCap, teacher support, and perceived academic achievement.PsyCap fully mediated the relationship between family functioning and perceived academic achievement. Teacher support significantly moderated the effect of family functioning on PsyCap and the entire mediating pathway. LPA identified three distinct PsyCap profiles: low (15%), moderate (60%), and high (25%). These profiles showed a stepwise pattern of significant differences in perceived academic achievement. The higher the levels of family functioning and teacher support, the more likely students were to be classified into the moderate or high PsyCap profiles, and teacher support exhibited a stronger effect. Discussion By integrating variable-centered and person-centered approaches, this study reveals that family functioning indirectly promotes perceived academic achievement by cultivating PsyCap, and that teacher support strengthens this transformative process, highlighting the synergistic effects of the family and school microsystems.

Clinical characteristics and in-hospital prognostic factors in young patients with myocardial infarction
abstractText: Objectives This study aims to analyze the clinical characteristics and short-term prognostic factors of young patients with acute myocardial infarction. Methods This retrospective observational study included young patients (aged 18 to 45 years) who visited our center for AMI from January 1, 2014, to October 31, 2023. Baseline and outcome data were collected through the medical records system, with the primary endpoint being in-hospital major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE). Patients were divided into MACE and non-MACE groups based on the occurrence of in-hospital MACE. Coronary angiography was performed in 154/158 patients, all achieving post-procedural TIMI 3 flow. Multivariable logistic regression using Firth penalized likelihood with a priori -selected variables (LVEF, serum uric acid, age) was used to identify independent predictors of MACE. Results Of 166 young patients initially screened, 158 were included in the final analysis after excluding 8 due to incomplete data. Among these, 27 (17.1%) experienced in-hospital MACE. Patients in the MACE group had a lower prevalence of diabetes (0.00% vs. 19.08%, P = 0.008), lower admission blood pressure and worse left ventricular dysfunction [lower left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF), larger left ventricular end diastolic diameter (LVEDD)]. Single-vessel disease was the most common (38.96%), with 83.77% of patients having involvement of the left anterior descending artery. The proportion of left main disease was higher in the MACE group (15.38% vs. 3.91%, P = 0.045). In the Firth model, lower LVEF was the sole independent predictor of MACE (OR 0.859, 95% CI 0.794–0.917, P < 0.001), while serum uric acid and age were not significant. Conclusion The clinical characteristics and coronary artery lesion features of young AMI patients are unique. Reduced LVEF is the sole independent predictor of in-hospital MACE in our cohort, underscoring the value of ventricular function assessment for short-term risk stratification.

Sỏi thận trên bệnh nhân thận lạc chỗ ít gặp nhưng điều trị khó khăn do đặc điểm giải phẫu bất thường. Trong bối cảnh hiện nay, nội soi tán sỏi thận bằng ống soi mềm với laser Holmium:YAG là phương pháp ít xâm lấn, an toàn, đang dần phổ biến. Phương pháp nghiên cứu: Chúng tôi báo cáo 1 trường hợp lâm sàng điều trị sỏi thận trên thận lạc chỗ vùng chậu thành công. Ca lâm sàng: Bệnh nhân nữ 48 tuổi, tiền căn chưa ghi nhận bệnh lý bất thường, nhập viện vì đau hạ vị. Khám bụng mềm, ấn đau nhẹ hạ vị. Hình ảnh cắt lớp vi tính hệ niệu xác định thận trái lạc chỗ vùng chậu, ứ nước độ II, sỏi bể thận trái kích thước 17×15 mm, độ Hounsfield khoảng 1400 HU, diện tích bề mặt sỏi khoảng 255 mm2, STONE Score: 8 điểm. Bệnh nhân được đặt thông double-J, sau 04 tuần tiến hành nội soi tán sỏi thận bằng ống soi mềm với laser được điều chỉnh chế độ tán (1 J, 20 Hz, 20 W). Thời gian phẫu thuật 45 phút, trong đó thời gian tán 30 phút. Sau mổ, bệnh nhân sạch sỏi hoàn toàn, không ghi nhận biến chứng, bệnh nhân được rút thông niệu đạo và thông double-J vào ngày thứ 04 sau mổ, xuất viện vào ngày thứ 05 sau mổ. Kết luận: Sỏi thận trên thận lạc chỗ là một bệnh lý hiếm gặp. Chúng tôi báo cáo một trường hợp được điều trị thành công bằng nội soi ống mềm tán sỏi, đạt tỷ lệ sạch sỏi hoàn toàn, không ghi nhận biến chứng và cho phép xuất viện sớm. Kết quả này cho thấy nội soi ống mềm là phương pháp khả thi, an toàn và hiệu quả đối với sỏi thận đơn giản trên thận lạc chỗ. Việc đặt thông double-J trước phẫu thuật có thể hỗ trợ quá trình đặt giá đỡ niệu quản thuận lợi hơn.

title: Assessing impact of climate change on medicinal plants through yield decline, metabolite variability and range shifts
abstractText: Abstract Climate change is one of the most grave environmental problems of the 21st century faced by organisms on Earth. It adversely impacts organisms including medicinal plants which contribute greatly to the healthcare system. It affects growth, chemistry and distribution of medicinal plants used as a source of medicine by people globally. An increase in the levels of greenhouse gases (GHG) due to anthropogenic activities has led to the warming of the Earth. This has caused a disturbance in the normal weather patterns thus causing fluctuations in a wide range of climate variables. In turn this threatens the survival of various medicinal plants which have been extensively discussed in this review. This comprehensive integrative review discusses how climate variability affects medicinal plants focusing on three key dimensions: growth and yield, secondary metabolites and geographical distribution. Relevant literature was retrieved from Scopus and Google Scholar through a structured search using Boolean logic and analysed to identify common patterns and knowledge gaps. Based on the findings, it was derived that plant phenology, productivity, metabolic pathways and natural habitats are impacted by climate. Besides accumulating existing evidence, the review presents an integrated framework which links plant growth, secondary metabolite variability and therapeutic potential to climatic changes, proposes a vulnerability-based classification of medicinal plants as per climate risk and identifies key research gaps which require further investigation. The review also discusses conservation strategies and emphasises adopting a multidisciplinary approach to ensure sustainability and therapeutic reliability of medicinal resources in a changing global climate.

title: Customer-Based Green Brand Equity: The Mediating Role of Psychological Ownership of Green Products among IKEA Family Members in Indonesia
abstractText: Background: This study advances Cue Utilization Theory and Psychological Ownership Theory by establishing psychological ownership as a pivotal mediating mechanism through which digital green product cues generate green brand value within digitally engaged loyalty communities. Objective: This study investigates how digital green product cues shape customer-based green brand equity via the psychological ownership of green products among IKEA Family Indonesia members. Methods: This study employed a quantitative survey design, collecting data from 348 purposively sampled IKEA Family Indonesia members. CB-SEM was applied to examine both direct and indirect pathways among the research variables. Results: Findings reveal that digital green product cues meaningfully strengthen psychological ownership of green products, which in turn elevates customer-based green brand equity. Moreover, psychological ownership of green products serves as a significant positive mediator in the pathway from digital green product cues to customer-based green brand equity. Conclusion: These results confirm that communicating sustainability credentials via digital channels both directly enhances green brand perception and cultivates a sense of product belonging that reinforces customer-based green brand equity.

abstractText: Đặt vấn đề: Chấn thương ngực kín (CTNK) là nguyên nhân tử vong phổ biến trong chấn thương và có thể để lại di chứng nặng nề. Thương tổn trong CTNK rất đa dạng, chẩn đoán dựa vào cơ chế chấn thương, đặc điểm lâm sàng và cận lâm sàng, điều trị các thương tổn thường gặp thường là điều trị bảo tồn và dẫn lưu khoang màng phổi. Mục tiêu nghiên cứu: Nghiên cứu đặc điểm lâm sàng, cận lâm sàng và đánh giá kết quả điều trị của bệnh nhân CTNK tại bệnh viện Đa khoa Thành phố Cần Thơ. Đối tượng và phương pháp nghiên cứu: Nghiên cứu hồi cứu mô tả trên 71 bệnh nhân (BN) CTNK được chẩn đoán và điều trị tại Khoa Ngoại lồng ngực Bệnh viện Đa khoa Thành phố Cần Thơ từ 04/2023 đến 06/2024. Kết quả: BN có tuổi trung bình là 52,6 ± 12, nam giới chiếm 77,5%, nguyên nhân chủ yếu là do tai nạn giao thông với 71,8%; đặc điểm lâm sàng đau ngực chiếm 100%. Gãy xương sườn thường gặp nhất (93%), tổn thương phổi - màng phổi chiếm 71,8%, trong đó: tràn máu màng phổi (33,8%), dập phổi (15,5%), tràn khí - máu màng phổi (7,0%), tràn khí màng phổi đơn thuần (15,5%). Có 70/71 BN được điều trị tốt (98,6%), trung vị thời gian nằm viện là 7 ngày. Kết luận: CTNK có nguyên nhân thường gặp nhất là tai nạn giao thông, nam giới chiếm đa số, nhóm 41 - 60 tuổi thường gặp nhất. Đau ngực là triệu chứng chủ yếu, gãy xương sườn là thương tổn thường gặp nhất. Gãy nhiều xương sườn làm tăng nguy cơ tổn thương phổi - màng phổi và thời gian nằm viện. Kết quả điều trị thành công chiếm tỷ lệ cao.

Moderate-scale operation of family farms in China: underlying logic, practical constraints, and optimization pathways for sustainable food systems
abstractText: The transformation of sustainable food systems must reconcile production efficiency and supply resilience with the protection of smallholder livelihoods, and for economies with large populations and limited arable land this reconciliation rests heavily on how the scale of family-farm operation is understood and organized. The academic community has long held theoretical disagreements on this issue between static efficiency standards and dynamic equilibrium perspectives, and no integrated explanatory framework that combines economic logic, social context and temporal dimensions has yet been established. Drawing on new institutional economics, economic sociology, family life-cycle theory and intergenerational transmission theory, and proceeding through theoretical deduction, institutional context analysis and secondary evidence from policy documents, official statistics and literature, this paper develops a triple-constraint dynamic equilibrium framework for the moderate-scale operation of family farms in China; its purpose is explanatory rather than estimative, since no uniform optimal scale is defensible across heterogeneous regional endowments, crop systems, service conditions and family structures. The framework holds that moderate scale is not a fixed value set externally but a dynamic equilibrium interval of operating scale: the economic-efficiency constraint sets its lower bound, the social-embeddedness constraint sets its upper bound, and the intergenerational-sustainability constraint operates as an independent temporal condition that also moderates the position and width of the interval as the family life cycle and succession arrangements change. Seen thus, the factor-market, organisational-coordination and temporal-dimension failures observable in practice appear as three structural tensions that jointly compress the feasible interval and constrain the contribution of family farms to sustainable food-system goals. The contribution lies in bringing social embeddedness and intergenerational sustainability into the analysis of moderate scale, moving beyond a single-efficiency account and offering an integrated explanatory framework for the evolution of family-farm scale in transition economies with fragmented landholdings and household-centred production. The framework applies directly to family farms and other family-centred operations; its three constraints are analytically general, whereas their relative binding strength, the interval's position and the associated policy instruments remain conditional on the institutional environment, particularly China's collective land ownership and household contract responsibility system, so that its reference value for other transition economies is conditional rather than universal.

Sesgo histórico y descolonización del currículo de Estudios Sociales: una revisión sistemática de la literatura
abstractText: Objetivo: Analizar la evidencia disponible sobre el sesgo histórico en la enseñanza de Historia y Estudios Sociales y examinar estrategias de descolonización curricular que contribuyan a una enseñanza histórica crítica, plural e intercultural. Metodología: Se realizó una revisión sistemática cualitativa de la literatura siguiendo las directrices PRISMA 2020. Se incluyeron 16 publicaciones académicas correspondientes al período 2020–2026, seleccionadas mediante criterios de inclusión y exclusión previamente establecidos. La evidencia se organizó en cinco categorías: sesgo histórico y narrativas eurocéntricas; multiperspectividad y pensamiento histórico; descolonización curricular y transformación epistémica; saberes indígenas e interculturalidad; y prácticas docentes y estrategias curriculares. Resultados: Los estudios revisados muestran que el sesgo histórico puede manifestarse mediante narrativas eurocéntricas, omisiones curriculares, representación desigual de actores históricos y limitada incorporación de perspectivas indígenas e interculturales. Asimismo, la multiperspectividad, el análisis crítico de fuentes, el reconocimiento de saberes indígenas, el diálogo intercultural y la revisión de narrativas hegemónicas aparecen como estrategias relevantes para transformar la enseñanza histórica. Conclusión: La descolonización del currículo de Estudios Sociales constituye un proceso multidimensional que requiere transformar no solo los contenidos, sino también las formas de seleccionar, interpretar y enseñar el conocimiento histórico, con el fin de favorecer una educación más crítica, plural e intercultural.

title: Mathematics anxiety and problem-solving ability in numerical methods courses: A repeated cross-sectional study across two Southeast Asian universities
abstractText: Mathematics anxiety (MA) impedes mathematical learning by taxing cognitive resources, negatively affecting problem-solving ability (PSA). Some evidence suggests that the strength and nature of this negative association may vary across educational and cultural contexts. However, cross-cultural studies on MA and PSA, especially in Southeast Asia, remain limited. This study investigated cohort-level patterns of MA and PSA in a transnational Numerical Methods course at Universiti Tun Hussein Onn Malaysia (UTHM) and Universitas Pahlawan (UP), Indonesia. The study spanned four independent cohorts from 2021 to 2024 and focused on institutional differences and temporal variation during a period of instructional transition. Using a repeated cross-sectional design, a total of 139 undergraduate students across four independent cohorts (UTHM: n=23; UP: n=116) were assessed during the 2021–2024 academic years using the Mathematics Anxiety Rating Scale and standardized problem-solving tests. Two-way factorial ANOVA examined the effects of university and cohort year on MA and PSA, and Pearson correlation analysis examined the association between the two constructs. A significant main effect of university indicated that UP students reported higher MA and lower PSA scores than UTHM students (p < 0.001). Significant year effects were observed for MA and PSA scores across successive cohorts (p ≤ 0.01), during a period characterized by a transition in instructional modalities from online to hybrid learning. Significant University×Year interactions indicated differing trends by institution. A moderate negative correlation between MA and PSA was observed (r = –0.49, p < 0.001).

title: PERANCANGAN VIDEO ANIMASI MOTION GRAPHIC SEBAGAI MEDIA PROMOSI DIGITAL UNTUK MENINGKATKAN DAYA TARIK PENGUNJUNG CAFE KAHAWA STREET
abstractText: Cafe Kahawa Street is a local culinary business located in Timu Rasanggaro Village and faces the challenge of low visitor attractiveness due to the lack of effective visual promotional media in the digital era. This research aims to design motion graphic animation videos as promotional media that can increase visitor attractiveness through the utilization of Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube social media. The method used is the Luther-Sutopo Multimedia Development Life Cycle (MDLC) consisting of six stages: concept, design, material collecting, assembly, testing, and distribution. Data were collected through direct observation, interviews with the cafe owner, and literature study, while validation was carried out by media experts and material experts as well as trials on potential visitors. The results showed that a 60-second motion graphic animation video with a 9:16 format was successfully designed using Adobe Illustrator, Adobe After Effects, Adobe Premiere Pro, and Adobe Audition. Media expert validation obtained an average score of 91% in the very feasible category, material experts 89.25% in the very feasible category, and prospective visitor responses 88.53% in the very attractive category. Implementation of the video on social media for 30 days resulted in a 147% increase in the number of visitors, a 183.3% increase in daily transactions, a 283.6% increase in Instagram followers, and a 271.4% increase in engagement rate. This research concludes that motion graphic animation videos are proven effective as promotional media that increases the attractiveness of visitors to Cafe Kahawa Street through the utilization of social media.

Water use strategies of Populus euphratica across age classes along groundwater depth gradients in the lower Tarim River
abstractText: How water source use and intrinsic water-use efficiency (iWUE) are linked across tree age classes under contrasting groundwater conditions remains unclear in desert riparian forests. We assessed water use strategies of young, middle-aged, and mature Populus euphratica in the lower Tarim River during ecological water conveyance (EWC) and non-EWC periods by combining hydrogen and oxygen stable isotopes of xylem and potential source waters with a Bayesian mixing model and leaf δ 13 C-derived iWUE. Across the five monitoring sections, mean groundwater depth was significantly lower during EWC than during non-EWC periods, averaging 4.7 and 4.9 m, respectively. At the Kunasite (DW) and Yingsu (F) sections, MixSIAR posterior mean contributions during EWC were 16.0–23.1% for groundwater, 14.4–17.6% for river water, and 6.6–19.0% for individual 40-cm soil layers. During non-EWC periods, posterior mean contributions from individual soil layers ranged from 10.9 to 20.3%, with relatively greater contributions from deeper layers. Associations between water source contributions and iWUE varied among age classes during EWC but were nonsignificant during non-EWC periods. Across sampling periods, mean iWUE was 58.29, 53.08, and 51.37 μmol mol −1 in young, middle-aged, and mature trees, respectively. The relationship between iWUE and groundwater depth also varied among sampling periods, with no consistent directional pattern. Based primarily on changes in the contributions of shallow and deep soil water along the groundwater depth gradient, we identified 4.5–6.0 m as a preliminary groundwater depth range associated with shifts in water source use by P. euphratica . These results show that water source use and iWUE in P. euphratica vary with hydrological conditions and tree age, providing empirical evidence for assessing its responses to EWC and groundwater variation in desert riparian forests.

title: Dietary dose-dependent effects of Ginkgo biloba leaf extract on growth, immunity, antioxidant status, and hepatic integrity in Nile tilapia
abstractText: Abstract The increasing demand for sustainable alternatives to in-feed antibiotics has stimulated interest in phytogenic feed additives. This study investigated the dose-dependent effects of dietary Ginkgo biloba leaf extract (GBLE: 0, 6, 12, 18, and 24 g/kg diet) in Nile tilapia during a 98-day feeding trial. A completely randomized design was used with three replicates per treatment (40 fish per hapa; initial body weight: 8.39 ± 0.14 g). Dietary GBLE supplementation improved final body weight, body weight gain, specific growth rate (SGR), and feed conversion ratio (FCR) in a dose-dependent manner, with the 18 g/kg group exhibiting superior performance ( P < 0.05). Second-order polynomial regression suggested estimated dietary levels of approximately 20.75 g/kg for maximum SGR and 16.44 g/kg for minimum FCR within the tested inclusion range. Polynomial regression identified optimal dietary levels of 20.75 g/kg for maximum SGR and 16.44 g/kg for minimum FCR. All GBLE-supplemented groups exhibited increased hemoglobin concentration, lymphocyte percentage, and total serum protein, together with lower serum cholesterol, triglycerides, and ALT activity. In addition, AST activity was reduced in fish fed the highest dietary GBLE level (24 g/kg). lysozyme activity, immunoglobulin M, and complement C3 were elevated in all GBLE groups relative to the control. Hepatic and serum antioxidant enzymes (SOD, GSH-Px) and total antioxidant capacity were increased, while malondialdehyde was markedly reduced across all supplemented groups. Intestinal amylase, lipase, and protease activities were enhanced. Representative liver sections from GBLE-supplemented fish showed well-preserved hepatocellular morphology, clearly defined sinusoidal spaces, and prominent pancreatic acini with no evidence of necrosis, inflammatory infiltration, or degenerative changes. These findings suggest that dietary GBLE at approximately 16–21 g/kg, as estimated by polynomial regression analysis under the present experimental conditions and supported by the superior responses observed in the 18 g/kg treatment group, may represent an exploratory inclusion range for Nile tilapia. However, these estimates should be validated in future practical studies before recommendation for commercial application. Within this range, the tested commercial GBLE preparation shows potential as a promising phytogenic feed additive that could contribute to reduced reliance on antibiotic growth promoters in intensive tilapia aquaculture.

abstractText: Mở đầu: Bệnh lý sỏi niệu đạo là một bệnh lý khá hiếm gặp trong sỏi đường tiết niệu. Nguyên nhân thường do bế tắc tại niệu đạo như xơ hẹp, túi thừa hoặc sỏi niệu đạo thứ phát từ đường tiết niệu trên kẹt lại tại những chỗ hẹp tự nhiên của niệu đạo. Hiện nay có nhiều phương pháp điều trị sỏi niệu đạo được các bác sĩ lâm sàng áp dụng, tuy nhiên vẫn chưa có báo cáo về kết quả điều trị của bệnh lý này. Trong bài viết này, chúng tôi đánh giá kết quả điều trị sỏi niệu đạo hiện tại. Phương pháp: Mô tả hồi cứu hàng loạt trường hợp được điều trị sỏi niệu đạo trong khoảng thời gian từ tháng 01/2019 đến tháng 12/2023. Kết quả: Trong 128 trường hợp được điều trị sỏi niệu đạo có 100% bệnh nhân nam, độ tuổi trung bình 49,9 ± 12,8 tuổi. Lý do nhập viện thường gặp nhất là tiểu khó, kích thước sỏi trung bình là 12,4 ± 5,1 mm, vị trí thường gặp nhất của sỏi là niệu đạo sau. Phương pháp điều trị chính là nội soi tán sỏi, với thời gian phẫu thuật trung bình là 34,7 ± 17,6 phút. Tai biến trong phẫu thuật thường gặp là tổn thương niêm mạc niệu đạo, biến chứng sau điều trị hay gặp là hẹp niệu đạo. Thời gian nằm viện sau phẫu thuật là 1,5 ± 1 ngày. Kết luận: Điều trị sỏi niệu đạo phụ thuộc vào vị trí và kích thước sỏi. Có nhiều phương pháp điều trị: Nội khoa, nội soi tán sỏi, kéo sỏi, phẫu thuật lấy sỏi hay dẫn lưu bàng quang ra da kèm tán sỏi. Nội soi tán sỏi là phương pháp điều trị hiệu quả, áp dụng được cho mọi vị trí sỏi.

title: Resistance of birch wood modified with sorbitol-citric acid to white-rot decay and weathering
abstractText: Abstract The increasing interest in sustainable and bio-based wood modification strategies has led to growing attention toward improving the performance of low-durability wood species for exterior applications. Sorbitol-citric acid (SorCA) modification has previously been reported as an effective approach for improving wood properties. However, despite these studies, the biological durability of SorCA-modified silver birch ( Betula pendula ), particularly its resistance to mold and fungal decay, has not been systematically investigated. Moreover, its performance under natural outdoor exposure conditions remains largely unexplored. Thus, this study evaluates the decay and outdoor weathering resistance of birch wood modified with a SorCA system. Birch wood samples were vacuum-pressure impregnated with aqueous solutions of SorCA at 20% and 40% w/w and cured at 140 °C. The distribution of the modifying agent within the wood structure was examined using X-ray microtomography, which confirmed effective penetration with partial or complete filling of the wood lumina by the in-situ formed polyester network. The modified samples were subjected to ten months of natural weathering, mold exposure under high humidity conditions, and also to white-rot fungi ( Trametes versicolor ). Outdoor weathering results indicated improved resistance to surface deterioration in modified wood, although increased color change (ΔE) was observed due to the formation of chromophoric groups during curing and subsequent photodegradation. Under the conditions investigated, SorCA modification enhanced biological durability and weathering resistance, especially at higher concentrations. In general, SorCA modification showed great potential to improve the durability of birch wood with enhancing biological durability and weathering resistance.

title: The Influence of Work Stress and Work-Life Balance on Employee Performance at the Perum Peruri Employee Cooperative
abstractText: Highlighting organizational challenges such as declining revenue and rising absenteeism that can impact workforce productivity. Objective : This study aims to analyze The Influence of Work Stress and Work-Life Balance on Employee Performance at the Perum Peruri Employee Cooperative. Methodology : This study employs a quantitative method with descriptive and verificative approaches. The study population consists of 45 employees, all of whom were included in the sample using a saturated sampling technique (census). Primary data were collected through the distribution of a five-point Likert scale questionnaire, while data analysis involved validity testing, reliability testing, classical assumption testing, multiple linear regression analysis, the coefficient of determination ( ) test, partial testing (t-test), and simultaneous testing (F-test). Research Results : The results indicate that, individually, Work Stress does not have a significant effect on Employee Performance (t=1.028; p=0.310), whereas Work-Life Balance has a positive and significant effect on Employee Performance (t=7.099; p<0.001; β=0.730). Simultaneously, Work Stress and Work-Life Balance significantly affect Employee Performance (F=27.002; p<0.001; R²=0.563). The coefficient of determination (R²) of 0.563 indicates that the two independent variables explain 56.3% of the variation in Employee Performance, while 43.7% is influenced by factors outside the research model. Work-Life Balance is the variable that exerts the most dominant influence on Employee Performance. Dominant here refers to having the largest standardized regression coefficient in the model; it does not imply that Work-Life Balance is the single most important factor within the organization.

title: Pengaruh Konsentrasi Pupuk Organik Cair Daun Gamal Terhadap Pertumbuhan Dan Hasil Tanaman Terung (Solanum melongena L.)
abstractText: Eggplant (Solanum melongena L.) is one of the horticultural crops with high economic value and good market potential. However, its growth and yield can be affected by low soil fertility, particularly limited organic matter and nutrient availability. Gamal leaves (Gliricidia sepium) contain essential nutrients such as nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium, which have the potential to be used as raw material for liquid organic fertilizer. This study aimed to determine the effect of different concentrations of gamal leaf liquid organic fertilizer on the growth and yield of eggplant. The research was conducted from January to May 2026 using a non-factorial Randomized Block Design with five treatments and five replications. The treatments consisted of P0 = 0 ml/L water, P1 = 50 ml/L water, P2 = 100 ml/L water, P3 = 150 ml/L water, and P4 = 200 ml/L water. The observed variables were plant height, number of leaves, fruit length, and fruit weight per plant. Data were analyzed using Analysis of Variance at the 5% level, followed by Duncan’s Multiple Range Test when significant differences were found. The results showed that gamal leaf liquid organic fertilizer affected the growth and yield of eggplant. The best treatment was P3 with a concentration of 150 ml/L water, which produced the highest plant height, number of leaves, fruit length, and fruit weight. Therefore, gamal leaf liquid organic fertilizer at 150 ml/L water can be recommended as an effective organic fertilizer to support eggplant cultivation

title: SCHWANNOMA DẠ DÀY, BÁO CÁO CA LÂM SÀNG HIẾM GẶP VÀ ĐIỂM LẠI Y VĂN

Health financing policy responses to economic crises in WANA countries: a systematic review (2008–2026)
abstractText: Abstract Background The West Asian and North African (WANA) region has faced severe macroeconomic shocks over the past two decades, including sanctions, currency devaluation, and austerity measures, which critically threaten health system sustainability and equity. Objective This systematic review examines macro-level health financing policy responses (revenue raising, risk pooling, and strategic purchasing) to economic crises in WANA countries (2008–2026). Methods Six electronic databases (PubMed, Scopus, WoS, Embase, EconLit, PAIS) and four grey literature sources were searched up to April 29, 2026. Institutional alignment was analyzed using the ‘abc’ structural model, and study quality was appraised using JBI, MMAT, and AACODS tools. Results From 3,455 initial records, 27 studies were included (23 high quality, 4 moderate). Structural misalignment (ΔE > 0) between policy goals, institutional tasks, and organizational positions was identified in 89% of the included studies (24 of 27), regardless of their quality rating. Sanctions predominantly disrupted pharmaceutical supply chains, while currency collapses eroded the health sector’s revenue base. Fragmented risk pooling in Lebanon and Jordan exacerbated health poverty during crises. Conclusion Redesigning institutional tasks (M₂) and establishing automatic counter-cyclical financing mechanisms are essential to enhance health financing resilience in WANA. Policymakers must align macro-fiscal mandates with health sector positions to prevent systemic collapse during economic shocks.

abstractText: Mục tiêu: Khảo sát sự thay đổi nồng độ CRP của ngày 3 so với ngày 1 trong tiên lượng biến chứng sốc nhiễm khuẩn, nhu cầu thở máy xâm nhập ở bệnh nhân nội trú do viêm phổi mắc phải cộng đồng (VPMPCĐ) và xác định ngưỡng cắt tối ưu của sự thay đổi này với các biến chứng trên. Đối tượng và phương pháp: Nghiên cứu đoàn hệ quan sát tiến cứu trên 128 bệnh nhân ≥18 tuổi nhập viện điều trị VPMPCĐ tại Bệnh viện Chợ Rẫy từ tháng 10/2024 đến 03/2025. Nồng độ CRP được định lượng bằng phương pháp đo độ đục miễn dịch có tăng cường latex. Kết quả: Tổng số 128 bệnh nhân có 71,1% trên 65 tuổi. Tỷ lệ sốc nhiễm khuẩn là 18,0% và thở máy xâm nhập là 21,2%. Sự thay đổi nồng độ CRP ngày 3 so với ngày 1 là yếu tố tiên lượng có ý nghĩa đối với biến chứng sốc nhiễm khuẩn và nhu cầu thở máy xâm nhập. Kết luận: Sự thay đổi CRP ngày 3 so với ngày 1 là yếu tố tiên lượng độc lập biến chứng sốc nhiễm khuẩn và nhu cầu thở máy xâm nhập ở bệnh nhân nội trú do VPMPCĐ. Trong đó, động học CRP thể hiện giá trị tiên lượng vượt trội trong dự đoán biến chứng sốc nhiễm khuẩn.

title: Diamond-based deep ultraviolet vortex beam generation with suppressed higher-order diffractions
abstractText: Optical vortices (OVs) with unique singular phase and orbital angular momentum are widely used in various applications including particle manipulation, microscopy, and imaging scenarios. Regardless, the undesired higher-order foci introduced by the conventional vortex lens such as spiral zone plates may lead to additional artifacts and thus degrade contrast sensitivity. In this endeavor, based on the typical trapezoidal contour matrix and the neural network-based inverse design approach, we propose an innovative single-focus OV lens termed trapezoidal spiral zone plates (TSZPs) to eliminate the higher-order foci which unavoidably exist in the conventional muti-foci lens. Considering the low thermal expansion of diamond materials, we have fabricated the TSZPs sample based on high-quality single-crystal diamond substrate using electron beam lithography. To verify the stable single-focus performance even under harsh environments of such optics, a demonstration experiment in the deep ultraviolet region has also been performed. These findings provide an avenue for improving the image performance of diamond-based optics in solar-blind imaging.

title: Whole-genome 5-hydroxymethylation profiling of human neurons for regulatory and biological insight
abstractText: Abstract While 5-methylcytosine (5mC) DNA methylation is a well-known player in genome stability and transcriptional regulation, the role of 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (5hmC), particularly prevalent in neurons, remains largely unknown. Here, we used long-read Oxford Nanopore Technology (ONT) to profile whole-genome, native 5mC and 5hmC levels in sorted neuronal nuclei samples from human post-mortem brain tissue. Genomic annotation revealed high 5hmC levels in actively transcribed genes and enhancers, which were enriched in neuron-related pathways, with functional variety when stratifying across chromatin states. Furthermore, 5hmC and 5mC modifications were enriched at transcription factor binding sites, affecting specific downstream regulatory networks. Altogether, our study demonstrates the potential of 5hmC and 5mC DNA modifications to provide biological insight into the regulatory landscape and function of human neurons.

title: Feasibility, acceptability, and preliminary estimates of a multimodal AKTIVER Heart Delirium Prevention Program in patients indicated for cardiac surgery: study protocol of a randomized controlled PREVENT POstoperative Delirium (PREVENT-POD) Pilot Study
abstractText: Abstract Background Postoperative delirium (POD) is a common complication in geriatric patients undergoing cardiac surgery. POD is associated with prolonged length of stay in the intensive care unit and hospital, increased mortality, institutionalization, distress, risk of cognitive impairment and dementia. The non-pharmacological, multimodal AKTIVER intervention from the multicenter PAWEL trial significantly reduced POD incidence and days with POD in older patients undergoing abdominal and orthopedic surgery. However, this positive effect on POD incidence has not yet been demonstrated in elderly patients undergoing cardiac surgery. Therefore, a specific AKTIVER Heart intervention with additional modules was developed. Methods In the randomized controlled PREVENT-POD pilot study, 60 patients aged 65 years or older undergoing elective cardiac surgery will be recruited and 2:1 randomized in either into the AKTIVER Heart intervention group (AKTIVER Heart) or treatment-as-usual plus (TAU+) group. In total, 40 patients will receive the non-pharmacological and modified AKTIVER Heart intervention, while the other 20 will receive TAU+ with preoperative education. The primary outcome is the feasibility and acceptability of the AKTIVER Heart intervention. Secondary outcomes include the preliminary estimates of the AKTIVER Heart on POD incidence, duration and severity, cognition, quality of life, sleep, treatment- and disease expectations, distress, depression, and anxiety symptoms. Discussion This randomized controlled pilot study aims to evaluate the feasibility and acceptability of the non-pharmacological, multimodal AKTIVER Heart intervention in elderly patients undergoing elective cardiac surgery. This trial is designed to provide evidence on acceptability and feasibility of the AKTIVER Heart, and to perform a larger, well-powered multicenter POD prevention trial in cardiac surgery. title: Mixture design optimization of Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) pâté formulated with mechanically separated meat: integration of sensory acceptance and formulation cost
abstractText: Abstract A significant portion of aquatic food industry by-products is still directed to low-value applications, even though they have technological potential for food products, such as mechanically separated meat (MSM) in emulsified products. This study optimised theformulation of a pasteurised Nile tilapia ( Oreochromis niloticus ) fish pâté using mixture design with component constraints, evaluating the combined effects of MSM, fat, and water on sensory performance and formulation cost. Eleven formulations were produced and assessed by 87 untrained panellists using a 9-point hedonic scale. The use of MSM met microbiological safety requirements. Significant differences were observed among formulations for sensory attributes, including odour, texture, flavour, overall acceptance, and purchase intention ( p < 0.05). Quadratic models demonstrated high predictive capacity, with adjusted coefficients of determination exceeding 0.99 for most responses. The optimal formulation based on desirability contained 0.53 MSM, 0.23 fat and 0.25 water, reaching an overall acceptance score of 7.71. An Economic-Sensory Efficiency Index (EI = overall acceptance/formulation cost, USD kg⁻¹) was proposed as a complementary decision criterion. Formulations with lower MSM content showed the highest EI values, maintaining acceptance above 7.1 while reducing formulation cost by up to USD 0.19 per kilogram. Redirecting MSM from fishmeal (USD 0.18 kg⁻¹) to pasteurised pâté production generated USD 3,633–4,831 in incremental gross profit per tonne of MSM, representing a value multiplication factor more than 20-fold.

abstractText: This study aims to analyze the influence of brand authenticity and emotional attachment on buying decisions, with brand trust serving as a mediating variable, among consumers of Donat Gula Padi in Garut Regency. The study employs a quantitative method using a survey approach. Data were collected via questionnaires distributed to 100 Generation Z respondents who had purchased or consumed Donat Gula Padi, utilizing a purposive sampling technique. Data analysis was conducted using Structural Equation Modeling-Partial Least Squares (SEM-PLS) with the aid of SmartPLS software. Model testing involved evaluating the outer model and inner model, as well as hypothesis testing via bootstrapping. The results indicate that brand authenticity has a positive and significant effect on brand trust and buying decisions; brand trust has a positive and significant effect on buying decisions; and emotional attachment has a positive and significant effect on both brand trust and buying decisions. Furthermore, the analysis of indirect effects reveals that brand trust mediates the influence of brand authenticity on buying decisions, as well as the influence of emotional attachment on buying decisions. These findings indicate that brand authenticity and consumer emotional attachment are crucial factors in building brand trust, which ultimately drives increased consumer buying decisions for Donat Gula Padi. The study offers implications for MSME operators to consistently maintain brand authenticity, strengthen emotional connections with consumers, and enhance brand trust in order to foster higher and sustainable buying decisions

Enhancing Care for Hospitalized Children With Medical Complexity via Targeted Education
abstractText: OBJECTIVES Children with medical complexity (CMC) and their caregivers face multifaceted challenges during hospitalization. Pediatric residents are often frontline clinicians for these patients but frequently identify feelings of inadequate preparedness to meet their care needs. We assessed the impact of a multimodal curriculum on common acute and chronic medical devices in CMC on caregiver-reported resident communication. We hypothesized that targeted education would translate to improved caregiver perception of family-centered communication. METHODS We implemented a novel medical device curriculum for pediatric residents at 2 children’s hospitals. Caregivers of hospitalized CMC completed a modified 14-item Communication Assessment Tool pre- and post-curricular intervention. We used generalized estimating equations at the caregiver level and paired t tests at the resident level to evaluate pre-post changes. We compared postintervention scores with those of a cohort of unexposed residents. RESULTS We collected 253 surveys on 39 pediatric residents. At the resident level, there was a statistical increase in overall mean score following intervention (pre, 4.844/5 [SD = 0.213]; post, 4.934/5 [SD = 0.132]; P = .0328). At the caregiver level, mean survey scores increased, although this was not statistically significant. Four of 14 survey items showed statistical improvement following intervention. Caregiver-level outcomes were consistent in the sensitivity analysis using an unexposed control, indicating robustness of findings. CONCLUSION Caregivers of CMC reported modest improvements in resident collaborative communication behaviors following intervention. Ongoing deliberate practice, including expanded educational models and the integration of caregiver feedback into physician evaluation tools, may further support skill development for clinicians caring for hospitalized CMC.

title: Case Report: Pelvic–perineal deep angiomyxoma presenting as hematoma-like paravaginal masses: a report of two cases
abstractText: Deep angiomyxoma (DAM) is a rare, locally infiltrative mesenchymal tumor of the female pelvic and perineal regions that is often misdiagnosed because of nonspecific clinical and ultrasonographic findings. We report two cases of pelvic–perineal DAM initially interpreted as paravaginal hematomas. One patient underwent ultrasound-guided aspiration and thrombin injection before progressive enlargement prompted further evaluation. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) demonstrated marked T2 hyperintensity, internal swirling structures, and extension along pelvic floor tissue planes, raising suspicion of DAM. Both patients underwent surgical resection with histologically negative margins (R0). Histopathology confirmed DAM with estrogen receptor and progesterone receptor positivity. Following multidisciplinary discussion, both patients received six cycles of individualized postoperative gonadotropin-releasing hormone agonist therapy. No radiological recurrence was observed at 11 and 12 months, respectively. Persistent or enlarging hematoma-like pelvic–perineal masses without a clear precipitating factor should prompt consideration of DAM and further MRI evaluation. MRI is useful for suggesting DAM and delineating tumor extent, whereas definitive diagnosis relies on histopathology. The benefit of routine postoperative endocrine therapy after R0 resection remains uncertain.

title: AI exposure and task detachability: migrant anchoring and work-linked health protection among highly educated foreign-born adults in the United States
abstractText: Background Occupation-level AI exposure indices describe the potential overlap between occupational work content and AI capabilities rather than individual AI use or employer adoption. However, task organisation and access to work-linked protections may differ across occupational contexts. We examined whether associations between a compound high-AIOE/high-task-detachability occupational profile and upstream insurance and material conditions varied by migrant anchoring among highly educated foreign-born adults in the United States. Methods We linked 2017–2024 IPUMS American Community Survey (ACS) data for adults aged 25–64 with a bachelor’s degree or higher to AI Occupational Exposure (AIOE) and O*NET 30.3 measures. High AIOE was defined as the top occupational quartile. The focal profile combined high AIOE with high task detachability and was compared with lower-AIOE occupations. Migrant anchoring combined citizenship, US residence duration, English proficiency, family co-residence, and homeownership; scores of 0–2 indicated lower anchoring. The three principal domain-specific outcomes were absence of employer- or union-linked health coverage from any eligible source among employed wage and salary workers, uninsurance, and family income below 200% of the federal poverty threshold. All-adult work-linked Social Reproduction Instability (W-SRI) ≥ 2 was retained as the focal cumulative summary measure. Weighted models were adjusted for demographic, regional, annual, and broad occupational characteristics. Inference used CR2/Satterthwaite covariance, wild cluster bootstrap tests, and leave-one-cluster-out analyses. Results The analysis included 746,995 foreign-born person-year observations, of which 22.47% were classified as having lower anchoring. Among adults with higher anchoring, the focal occupational profile and lower-AIOE occupations showed few differences in the four principal outcomes. Among adults with lower anchoring, the focal occupational profile was associated with a lower prevalence of all four adverse outcomes. The corresponding between-stratum differences were −10.68 percentage points for absence of employer- or union-linked coverage, −6.75 percentage points for uninsurance, −7.90 percentage points for poverty, and −7.55 percentage points for cumulative burden. Magnitudes remained similar after excluding 2020, restricting the sample to 2018–2024, adding state fixed effects, and restricting the sample to currently employed respondents. In the labour force-restricted analysis, the unemployment modification was −0.37 percentage points (95% CI −1.15 to +0.42) and was imprecisely estimated. Conclusion Among highly educated foreign-born adults with lower anchoring, the compound occupational profile was associated with a lower prevalence of coverage absence, uninsurance, poverty, and cumulative burden than occupations with lower AIOE. The findings describe occupation-level differences in upstream insurance and material conditions rather than causal effects of AI adoption or task detachability.

title: Regional neurodevelopmental and psychosocial encounters for children with CHD: an updated validation cohort from Northern New England
abstractText: Abstract We have previously described how children with complex CHD access developmental and psychosocial services in Maine, most often beyond the reach of the surgical centre. In this follow-up study, we describe a similar pattern for children in Vermont. Of 406 at-risk children between 2017 and 2019, 37% had an encounter. Very few individuals underwent developmental assessment or psychological or neuropsychological testing (1–4%). Visit volume was highest for mental health assessments in children older than 5 years and occurred predominately in community clinics and private practices close to home.

abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui dan menganalisis pengaruh Selera, Citra Merek, dan Komunitas terhadap Keputusan Pembelian Brand Converse. Metode pengumpulan data yang digunakan adalah data primer dengan menggunakan kuesioner. Pendekatan yang digunakan peneliti yaitu menggunakan penelitian kuantitatif. Populasi yang digunakan dalam penelitian ini adalah pengguna Converse yang berasal dari Kota Surabaya berumur 14 tahun keatas yang pernah membeli atau menggunakan Brand Converse. Teknik pengambilan sampel yang digunakan dalam penelitian ini dengan metode Purposive Sampling karena pemilihan sampel dengan kriteria yang ditentukan. Jumlah sampel yang didapatkan sebanyak 100 responden. Teknik pengambilan sampel menggunakan teknik non probability sampling. Model analisis data yang digunakan adalah analisis regresi linier berganda dengan bantuan SPSS versi 26. Hasil penelitian ini menunjukkan selera berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap keputusan pembelian, citra merek berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhada keputusan pembelian, dan komunitas berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap keputusan pembelian.

title: How do First-Year, First-Time Regional University Students Respond to Expectation-Experience Mismatches?
abstractText: First-year, first-time (FYFT) students enter university with expectations shaped by institutional recruitment communications, social media, and broader media narratives. During transition, lived experiences may diverge from these expectations, creating expectation-experience mismatch. While student expectations and satisfaction are well researched, less is known about how students respond to expectation-experience mismatch and how these responses influence satisfaction. Drawing on cognitive dissonance and coping response literature, this study examines FYFT students in regional Australian universities. Data were collected through a national survey of 405 students and analysed using structural equation modelling. Findings show that expectations were associated with both positive and negative emotional response outcomes, and that these outcomes influenced satisfaction. Positive emotional response outcomes had a stronger relationship with satisfaction than negative emotional response outcomes. The study reframes expectation-experience mismatch as a common feature of transition and highlights the value of student-driven strategies that strengthen constructive action and student agency during the first year.

title: Surgical repair of facial nerve defects by an autologous great auricular nerve transplantation: a retrospective, 12-month, follow-up study
abstractText: Background To observe facial nerve function recovery from an autologous great auricular nerve (GAN) transplantation in repairing facial nerve defects. Methods Thirty-six patients were included. Facial nerve functions were evaluated by using the House–Brackmann grading system. Abnormal sensations after the GAN sacrifice were recorded. Results The follow-up lasted for an average of 18.5 (12–60) months. Facial nerve defects were caused by parotid gland malignancies ( n = 30) or trauma ( n = 6), with an average length of 2.6 ± 1.1 (1.0–6.5) cm. One case showed tumor recurrence during the follow-up. Lack of feeling (78.1%) was the dominant postoperative abnormal sensation, followed by lack of sensitivity (53.1%) and abnormal sensation (40.6%). Long facial nerve defects (>3 cm) and preoperative facial paralysis combined with parotid gland malignancies retarded facial nerve function recovery. Conclusion Autologous GAN transplantation is effective for repairing facial nerve defects and recovering facial nerve function during the 12-month follow-up period.

Sustainable digitalization in education: perspectives of Latvian educational professionals
abstractText: Introduction The fields of education and sustainable development are currently facing several challenges resulting from the rapid development of digital technologies. Education is considered a fundamental prerequisite both for achieving sustainable development and for fostering the meaningful and responsible use of digital technologies. However, the role of digital technologies in promoting sustainable development has often been approached in a narrow and superficial manner. This study explores perceptions of digital sustainability (“digitainability”) among Latvian educational professionals. Methods The research involved semi-structured interviews with Latvian teachers ( n = 3) and a focus group discussion with school representatives ( n = 5). The qualitative data were analyzed using thematic analysis. Results The findings indicate that professionals' views on the role of digital technologies in promoting sustainability are predominantly focused on individual projects and isolated activities rather than on a systematic and long-term strategic approach. Teachers emphasized that digital technologies are perceived as an externally imposed and unavoidable component of the educational process rather than as a pedagogical choice grounded in teachers' own professional beliefs and values. Discussion The study highlights the importance of considering environmental, pedagogical, and ethical dimensions when examining sustainable digitalization in school practice. The findings also illustrate participants' perceived tensions between institutionally driven digitalization and sustainability considerations in everyday educational practice.

title: Circulating musclin as a potential prognostic biomarker for major adverse cardiovascular events in surgically treated acute aortic dissection: a retrospective cohort study
abstractText: Background Musclin is a skeletal muscle-derived myokine with reported cardioprotective effects; however, its prognostic relevance in acute aortic dissection (AAD) remains uncertain. This study examined whether admission Musclin levels were associated with postoperative major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) and whether they added prognostic information beyond conventional clinical indicators. Methods We retrospectively enrolled 108 surgically treated AAD patients from 2022 to 2023. Musclin levels were measured by ELISA in residual serum samples collected at admission. The primary endpoint was composite MACE. Kaplan–Meier survival analysis, multivariate Cox regression, time-dependent ROC, IDI and NRI were used to evaluate the predictive and incremental value of Musclin. Results During 400-day follow-up, 36 patients (33.3%) developed MACE. The CART-derived optimal Musclin cutoff was 4.815 ng/mL. Kaplan–Meier analysis showed that low Musclin group had significantly higher MACE cumulative incidence than high Musclin group (48.2% vs. 17.3%, log-rank P < 0.001). Multivariate Cox regression confirmed circulating Musclin associated with a lower risk of MACE (HR = 0.314, 95%CI: 0.104–0.943, P = 0.039). Time-dependent AUC analysis demonstrated that the combined model incorporating Musclin (model 2) achieved superior AUC compared with the clinical model (model 1). Even at the 250-day time point, where the incremental gain ( Δ AUC) was minimal, the combined model still exhibited significantly better discriminative performance (0.876 vs. 0.837, DeLong P = 0.013). At the 250-day landmark, IDI was 0.153 (95%CI: 0.018–0.286, P = 0.012) and overall NRI was 0.167 (95%CI: 0.003–0.336, P = 0.044), with event-specific NRI reaching 0.361 ( P = 0.012). Sensitivity analyses yielded directionally consistent associations when Musclin was analyzed using the cohort median or as a continuous variable. Conclusions In this single-center retrospective cohort, lower admission Musclin was associated with a higher risk of postoperative MACE. Musclin may be a severity-related biomarker that could complement conventional risk indicators, but its independent clinical utility, optimal threshold, and role in risk stratification require prospective multicenter validation with comprehensive perioperative adjustment before clinical use.

title: Perceived academic demands and psychological distress among Chinese university students: structural associations involving chronic time pressure and leisure-time physical activity
abstractText: Objectives This study examined the direct and specific indirect associations among perceived academic demands, chronic time pressure, leisure-time physical activity, and psychological distress in Chinese university students. Methods A cross-sectional online survey included 1,390 undergraduates from 10 higher-education institutions in Jiangsu Province, China. Perceived academic demands, chronic time pressure, and psychological distress were modeled as latent variables, whereas log-transformed leisure-time physical activity was modeled as an observed variable. Confirmatory factor analysis and covariate-adjusted structural equation modeling were conducted. Specific indirect associations were estimated using 5,000 bootstrap resamples with bias-corrected 95% confidence intervals. Results The adjusted structural model showed good fit (CFI = 0.966, TLI = 0.959, RMSEA = 0.034, SRMR = 0.024). Perceived academic demands were positively associated with chronic time pressure (β = 0.539) and psychological distress (β = 0.382). Chronic time pressure was positively associated with psychological distress (β = 0.334) and negatively associated with leisure-time physical activity (β = −0.179), whereas leisure-time physical activity was negatively associated with distress (β = −0.097; all p < 0.001). The specific indirect association through chronic time pressure was B = 0.182 (95% bias-corrected CI [0.134, 0.236]), whereas the serial specific indirect association additionally involving leisure-time physical activity was considerably smaller ( B = 0.010, 95% bias-corrected CI [0.005, 0.018]). Conclusions The indirect association through chronic time pressure was substantially larger than the serial indirect association additionally involving leisure-time physical activity, indicating that leisure-time physical activity made only a minimal additional contribution within the concurrent structural model. These findings highlight chronic time pressure as a relevant correlate of student psychological distress and support further investigation of academic time organization alongside opportunities for physical activity. Because the data were cross-sectional, temporal mediation and causal direction cannot be established.

title: Knowledge gaps and practices for glaucoma among adults in Palestine: a cross-sectional study
abstractText: Background Glaucoma is a leading cause of irreversible blindness globally, often progressing asymptomatically until advanced stages. Awareness and knowledge of glaucoma are critical determinants of early diagnosis and treatment-seeking behavior. Data on glaucoma awareness in Palestine are scarce. This study aimed to assess the level of awareness, knowledge, and attitudes regarding glaucoma among the general Palestinian population and to identify sociodemographic factors associated with inadequate knowledge. Methods A population-based cross-sectional study was conducted from December 1 to December 30, 2025, using an online questionnaire distributed to adults (≥18 years) residing in the West Bank and Jerusalem. The questionnaire included sociodemographic information, glaucoma awareness, knowledge, attitudes, and practices. Reliability was assessed using Cronbach’s alpha (α = 0.87). Knowledge scores were calculated with a maximum of 8 points; good knowledge was defined as ≥6 correct answers. Data were analyzed using SPSS v23, employing chi-square tests and multivariable logistic regression. Results A total of 741 participants completed the survey (50.2% male, 49.8% female). Overall, 54% had heard of glaucoma, but only 13.8% demonstrated good knowledge. Prior awareness of glaucoma was the strongest predictor of good knowledge (aOR = 7.89, p < 0.001). Knowledge gaps were notable regarding the asymptomatic nature of early disease (20.9%), irreversible vision loss (57%), and key risk factors including age ≥40 years (49%), family history (44.9%), and diabetes (55.1%). Older adults, rural residents, and individuals with lower educational levels had significantly lower knowledge scores. Only 26.9% of participants reported eye examinations within the preceding year, and screening intentions were associated with better knowledge (p = 0.015). Conclusions Although awareness of glaucoma is moderate in Palestine, comprehensive knowledge remains low, particularly among high-risk populations. Public health interventions should target education beyond name recognition, emphasizing asymptomatic progression, irreversible vision loss, and risk factors. Integrating glaucoma education into clinical visits and community-based programs may improve early detection and prevent blindness.

Hybrid deep learning for three-way classification of human-written, AI-generated, and AI-rephrased text
abstractText: Abstract The rapid proliferation of large language models (LLMs) has made it increasingly difficult to distinguish AI-generated and AI-rephrased text from authentic human writing, posing serious risks to academic integrity, journalism, and e-commerce credibility. This paper presents a rigorous benchmark evaluation for three-way AI text origin classification designed to detect human-written, AI-generated, and AI-rephrased text by integrating handcrafted linguistic features, transformer-based contextual embeddings, and ensemble learning strategies. A corpus of 161,788 samples is curated from Amazon product reviews and Twitter posts, with AI-generated text produced via zero-shot prompting and AI-rephrased text produced via few-shot prompting using GPT, DeepSeek, and Kimi. The corpus comprises 46,844 human-written, 57,247 AI-generated, and 57,697 AI-rephrased samples distributed across training (113,249), validation (16,180), and test (32,359) splits. A hybrid feature vector of 168 dimensions is constructed, combining 68 handcrafted stylistic, lexical, linguistic, syntactic, and stylometric features with 100-dimensional embeddings derived from RoBERTa and the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 Sentence Transformer. Classical machine learning models, Random Forest, SVM, and Logistic Regression, are trained on this hybrid representation, while RoBERTa-base and DeBERTa-v3-base are fine-tuned end-to-end on raw tokenized text. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that transformer models substantially outperform classical methods, with RoBERTa achieving 95.49% accuracy and DeBERTa-v3 achieving 94.88%. A probability-averaging ensemble further improves accuracy to 95.66%, and a stacking ensemble with a Random Forest meta-learner reaches 96.46%. Ablation studies confirm the complementary value of handcrafted features alongside contextual embeddings. Across all models, AI-rephrased content is the most challenging category due to its semantic proximity to human writing, highlighting a persistent frontier for future research. The dataset and evaluation framework provide a reproducible foundation for future AI content detection research, with generalization to unseen generators and domains identified as primary directions for future work.

The Multidimensional Nature of Pediatric Patient Complexity
abstractText: OBJECTIVE Patient complexity is defined in a variety of ways and is associated with health care costs and use. In this study, we evaluate whether pediatric inpatient complexity represents a single construct or multiple domains using multiple measures of diagnostic burden, health care use, and intensity. METHODS We analyzed administrative billing data from pediatric hospitals in the Pediatric Health Information System (PHIS) including medical and surgical hospitalizations discharged from 2021 to 2023 for patients aged 0 to 17 years with lengths of stay (LOS) of 30 days or fewer. We extracted measures of hospital use and clinical characteristics including LOS, readmissions, diagnosis and procedure codes, billing codes, and clinical classifications. For each discharge, we calculated measures capturing diagnostic burden, overall use and intensity, including unique diagnosis codes, unique items, services, and medications received, and complex chronic organ systems. We performed a principal components analysis (PCA) to examine patterns of shared variation and underlying dimensions among the included measures. RESULTS We included N = 2 090 139 discharges from 48 hospitals. Over three-quarters (79.5%) were medical admissions and 85% stayed less than 1 week. Our PCA identified 9 factors accounting for 74.1% of the variance. The first 3 factors comprised measures of diagnostic complexity (accounting for 20% of variance), use of medications, supply, and other items or services (17%), and procedural and overall use including LOS and intensive care unit use (10%). CONCLUSIONS Our findings indicate pediatric inpatient complexity is multidimensional, with 9 distinct factors identified by PCA that may have important implications for health services research, quality measurement, and risk adjustment.

title: Perancangan dan Implementasi Sistem Informasi Desa Berbasis Web
abstractText: Anapallu Village, Central Sumba Regency, still uses conventional processes in population data management, correspondence administration services, and information delivery to the community. This condition causes services to be less effective and people have to come directly to the village office to obtain information and administrative services. This research aims to design and implement a web-based Village Information System that can help village officials manage data and provide services to the community more quickly and easily. The development of the system uses the Waterfall method which includes needs analysis, design, implementation, and testing. Data collection is carried out through observation, interviews, and documentation. The system was developed using PHP and MySQL with features of population data management, letter submission, news, announcements, profiles, and village galleries. The system test uses the Black-Box Testing method to ensure that each function runs as needed. The system developed is expected to increase the effectiveness of administrative services and make it easier for the community to obtain information about Anapallu Village quickly and transparently.

title: Correlating biaxial stress to metastable phases in Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 on substrates with different coefficients of thermal expansion
abstractText: The effects of biaxial stress in hafnium zirconium oxide (HZO) thin films on the phase constitution and dielectric response are studied through the preparation of HZO films on substrates with coefficients of thermal expansion (CTE) ranging from 0.52 to 12.97 × 10−6 K−1. X-ray diffraction-based stress measurements revealed a systematic decrease in film biaxial tensile stress with increasing substrate CTE. Grazing incidence and attenuated total reflectance Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy revealed spectral energy shifts that scale with film stress, proving vibrational spectroscopy as an additional indicator of film stress. Ferroelectric responses are observed in HZO prepared on low CTE substrates, and antiferroelectric-like responses are observed in films on high CTE substrates. Results indicate that reducing substrate CTE increases tensile biaxial stress and results in higher fractions of the metastable polar orthorhombic phase. High substrate CTE values lead to low HZO stress values and spectroscopic and antiferroelectric responses consistent with the presence of the antipolar o-I phase.

title: Scalable quaternary topological insulator for low-power spintronics
abstractText: Topological insulators (TIs) with spin-momentum-locked surface states exhibit high charge-to-spin (C2S) conversion efficiency. However, binary and ternary TIs are constrained by a narrow tunable composition window for their insulating bulk states, which limits spintronic performance due to interference from bulk conduction. This work reports the development of a high-quality quaternary TI, [Sb2Te3(5−t)/Bi2Se3(t)]4, fabricated via scalable magnetron sputtering. By tuning the Bi2Se3 layer thickness, the quaternary TI exhibits high resistivity and low carrier concentration, effectively suppressing bulk conduction across a broad tunable window. Over a wide Bi2Se3 thickness range (t = 0.2–1.5 nm, corresponding to 3%–23% Bi2Se3 content), a high spin Hall angle (θSH) of 0.4–0.99 is maintained. Furthermore, in heterostructures based on this quaternary TI, the critical magnetization switching current density drops to as low as 3.3 × 105 A/cm2, which is two orders of magnitude lower than that of heavy metal Pt. Owing to the large spin Hall angle, the quaternary TI also exhibits power consumption approximately 20 times lower than ternary TIs for t = 0.2–1.5 nm. These results confirm that scalable quaternary TIs enable low-power spintronic devices with enhanced efficiency and processing flexibility, paving the way for advanced spintronic applications.

Supernatants from stored platelet concentrates modulate the inflammatory response in platelet-depleted blood ex vivo
abstractText: Introduction Platelets contain a wide range of bioactive mediators, many of which accumulate during storage of platelet concentrates and have immunomodulatory properties. Our objective was to investigate how mediators derived from stored platelet concentrates modulate the acute inflammatory response using an ex vivo model. Methods Platelet-depleted whole blood from healthy donors (n=8) was supplemented with pooled platelet concentrate supernatants generated from six platelet concentrates sampled on storage days 1, 3, 5, and 7, and incubated with or without heat-inactivated Escherichia coli for four hours at 37 °C. Inflammatory responses were assessed by measuring complement activation, platelet-derived mediators, and cytokines. Results In the absence of E. coli , addition of platelet concentrate supernatants increased the levels of 24 of 32 measured inflammatory mediators. In contrast, under E. coli -stimulated conditions, the supernatants increased 10 markers and attenuated 14 markers, including the key pro-inflammatory cytokines IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF. The attenuation of these cytokines ranged from 25-43%, whereas several other mediators were unchanged or increased. The majority of biomarkers showed limited differences across the investigated storage time points. Conclusions Our findings demonstrate that soluble factors released from platelet concentrates can modulate inflammatory responses in platelet-depleted blood in an ex vivo setting, with context-dependent, bidirectional, and selective immunomodulatory effects.
